{{Quote|One cannot do less than is required, nor more than is allowed.|Pons Limbic|<ref name="Rules Supplement">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|parent=2}} {{C|[https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/anewhoperules.pdf Rules Supplement]}}</ref>}}
'''Pons Limbic''' was a [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who frequnted [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-attunement|Force-attuned]]<ref name="ANH Limited" /> [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]] [[Gender/Legends|male]],<ref name="GalacticFiles" /> Pons Limbic frequented [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|90|Brainiac}}</ref> in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Mos Eisley">{{DB|location|moseisley|Mos Eisley}}</ref> The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[BoShek/Legends|BoShek]] gave him the nickname "Brainiac" because Limbic could calculate [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] coordinates without the help of a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]].<ref name="GalacticFiles" /> 

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> Limbic visited the cantina and sat at a table with<ref name="GalacticFiles" /> the [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Arleil Schous/Legends|Arleil Schous]],<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> the [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Hem Dazon/Legends|Hem Dazon]],<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> the [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] smuggler [[Bom Vimdin/Legends|Bom Vimdin]],<ref name="Cracken">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref> and the patron [[Braconnor Bakiska/Legends|Braconnor Bakiska]].<ref name="GalacticFiles" />

==Personality and traits==
Limbic had a super-intelligent appearance,<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Legacy Collection|pack=#35: Pons Limbic|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TLC35pons.asp}}</ref> [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin,<ref name="HS" /> and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="ANH Limited" /> 

==Skills and abilities==
The Siniteen could calculate hyperspace jumps<ref name="GalacticFiles" /> and coordinates<ref name="CSWE" /> in his head, without the aid of a navigation computer. This was considered to be a worthwhile and extremely impressive skill. Limbic had high intelligence<ref name="GalacticFiles" /> and though he was Force-attuned,<ref name="ANH Limited" /> he had low [[The Force/Legends|Force]] power.<ref name="GalacticFiles" />

==Behind the scenes==
During production of ''A New Hope'', the character was referred to as "Brainee," "Cranium Head" and "Crater Head."<ref name="Cantina Roll Call">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref> It was the CCG that first gave him his nickname "Brainiac," and his true name was not revealed until the article "Cantina Roll Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases" was updated for the 2008 [[StarWars.com]] site redesign.<ref name="Cantina Roll Call 2">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref>

Both the [[Wikipedia:Pons|pons]] and the [[Wikipedia:Limbic system|limbic system]] are structures within the human brain.

[[Wikipedia:Brainiac (comics)|Brainiac]] is also the name of a character in the [[Wikipedia:DC Universe|DC Universe]].
